raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Technology Project Manager with 15+ years of experience across Banking and Financial Services, specialising in Payments, Core Banking, and large-scale technology transformation programs. Proven track record leading end-to-end project lifecycles — from planning, budgeting, and resourcing through delivery and production support — at BNY Mellon, Citibank, and Webster Bank. Deep expertise in ISO 20022 migration (TWIST, CAMT.086, EDI 822), Agile/Scrum delivery, cross-functional team management, and stakeholder engagement at senior levels. Adept at managing SIT, UAT, regression, and DR testing cycles, driving automation initiatives, and overseeing cloud-based data transformation projects across US, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA regions.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Project Delivery: End-to-end project lifecycle management | Planning, estimation, budgeting & resourcing | Agile/Scrum delivery | Sprint planning & release management Payments & Banking: ISO 20022 migration (TWIST XML/BSB, CAMT.086, EDI 822) | Core Banking & Corporate Banking | Fixed Income, Derivatives & Securities Operations | Global Billing (ORMB) Testing & Quality: SIT, UAT, Regression, DR & Performance Testing | Test strategy & defect resolution | End-to- end validation across parallel environments Data & Technology: Data migration & transformation | Cloud (AWS, Snowflake) | SQL & PL/SQL | API & integration validation | BI (Tableau, SAP BO) | AI/GenAI Leadership: Cross-functional team management | Stakeholder & executive engagement | Risk, controls & governance | Change & transformation management Tools: JIRA · Confluence · SharePoint · Oracle ORMB · SmartStream TLM · Tableau · SAP BO · SQL · Excel · Visio · NDM · SFTP
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AVP – Senior Specialist, Business Technology Liaison (Reconciliation) | Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) | Jan 2023 – Apr 2026
Project Delivery: Led end-to-end daily, weekly, and monthly Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation transformation programme across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS for fixed income, financing, and related products — ensuring completion before trading-hour deadlines across global regions.
Lifecycle Management: Managed full project lifecycle including requirement gathering, test strategy definition (SIT, UAT, regression), milestone tracking, RAID logs, and action item trackers across all reconciliation workstreams.
Transformation & Automation: Drove reconciliation automation and AI-enabled capabilities spanning multiple source systems (FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, Invest One/FIS), reducing operational risk and manual data load.
Data Migration: Defined Business Requirement Documents, workflows, and validation criteria for internal and external data migration to the RDZ platform via NDM/SFTP — aligning with data transformation and integration best practices.
Process Improvement: Enabled Feed Advancement (Time Discrepancy) and Unknown Data Cleansing initiatives, accelerating early reconciliation and NAV calculation for trading teams.
Team Leadership: Managed and mentored a team of 6 analysts across multiple transformation workstreams, fostering professional growth and operational excellence.
Stakeholder Management: Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client, and Technology teams; managed escalations with custodians on break resolution, trade settlements, and SLA compliance. • Governance & Reporting: Maintained project artefacts including charters, integrated timelines, and process flows in JIRA and Confluence; provided regular status updates to senior stakeholders. • Risk & Compliance: Continually reassessed operational and technology risks in line with regulatory requirements and governance frameworks.
System Engineer – Lead Analyst | Tata Consultancy Services (Webster Bank Engagement) | Jan 2021 – Dec 2022
Cloud Data Transformation: Led end-to-end data migration from Central Data Repository (CDR/Oracle) to AWS-based Webster Data Repository (WDR) using Snowflake — ensuring data quality, regulatory compliance, and integration integrity throughout.
BI Modernisation: Managed migration of SAP Business Objects reports to Tableau, delivering modern self-service BI capabilities for business users across the organisation.
Requirements & Testing: Defined business requirements, led UAT testing, and developed process flows to enhance system integration efficiency; provided training on new platform SOPs.
Delivery: Delivered cloud-based reporting architecture enabling data-driven decision-making — demonstrating hands-on experience with cloud technologies and data integration platforms.
System Engineer – Project Manager, Global Billing Analytics (CIB) / Cash Operations | Tata Consultancy Services (Citibank) | Jul 2015 – Aug 2020
ISO 20022 & ORMB Leadership: Led end-to-end ORMB onboarding, implementation, and rollout across Trade and Treasury Solutions as Subject Matter Expert for ISO 20022 Global Billing including TWIST XML/BSB, CAMT.086, EDI 822, and CSS formats across US, Canada, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA. • Testing: Executed comprehensive UAT, SIT, Functional, Regression, and Performance testing cycles for ORMB and enterprise billing platforms — validating billing configurations, pricing calculations, invoicing workflows, payment processing, and transaction accuracy across multiple parallel environments.

Budget & Resource Management: Managed project budgets, resource planning, and delivery milestones; prepared Cap Plan, MIS, KPI, and ad hoc tracker reports for senior stakeholder review during weekly and monthly business reviews.
Re-engineering & Automation: Led multiple platform re-engineering and automation initiatives across ORMB, GCAR, ECIF, Vanguard Big Data, IGS, and CRM notification distribution — significantly reducing manual reporting effort and improving data accuracy.
Client Onboarding: Managed client onboarding for Turkey, Puerto Rico, UAE, Hong Kong, and Singapore with zero data quality issues; coordinated UAT sign-off and end-to-end validation for global billing invoices.
API & Integration: Supported API and integration validation for billing system interfaces; performed backend validation using Oracle SQL for billing data reconciliation and pricing accuracy checks. • Team Management: Led a team of 4, championing an inclusive mentoring culture and promoting compliance, accountability, and operational excellence.
Workflow Specialist – Loss Mitigation | Tata Consultancy Services (CitiMortgage) | Oct 2010 – Jul 2015
Managed Citi Mortgage Loss Mitigation Programme under FHA, VA, FHLMC, and FNMA guidelines; prepared MIS, KPI, and audit reports ensuring SLA compliance.
Trained and mentored new employees on loan modifications, HAMP, short sale programmes, and financial documentation requirements.
Senior Customer Service Executive | Intelenet Global Services (Barclays) / Wipro BPO (Delta Airlines) | Feb 2005 – Oct 2010
Resolved inbound customer queries across Online, Branch, and Funds Transfer banking; mentored new joiners on COPC guidelines. Awarded Best Advisor for 100% RBSM Quality Scores (Oct–Nov 2009).
Handled airline reservations, cancellations, and ticket reissues; trained on IATA, Galileo, and CRM platforms. Recognised as Rep of the Quarter (2005).
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Led ISO 20022 transformation (TWIST, CAMT.086, EDI 822) across 5+ global regions at Citibank with zero data quality issues — directly relevant to enterprise-scale payments modernisation programmes.
Directed cloud data migration (Oracle CDR to AWS/Snowflake) at Webster Bank, demonstrating hands-on delivery of large-scale cloud-based integration programmes.
Automated multiple manual reconciliation processes across Eagle, FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, and Invest One at BNY Mellon, eliminating manual dependency and accelerating NAV calculation for traders. • Led daily Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation cycles across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS, ensuring accuracy prior to trading-hour deadlines across global regions.
Drove Vanguard Big Data TWIST migration, ensuring data quality parity between new and legacy Linux- based environments.
Directed Unknown Data Cleansing initiative, strengthening compliance posture and data governance across multi-region operations.
Received direct client recognition for organisational excellence, backup data availability, and follow-through on complex reconciliation investigations.
